name: DecomposeByBusinessCapability
summary: Draws a service around one business capability — something the business does in order to generate value — so that a change to that capability lands in one service and one team.

roles.name: DecomposeByBusinessCapability
roles.summary: The service drawn around one capability — order management, inventory management — rather than around a layer, an entity or a team's convenience. The claim is checkable by review and by nothing else: a requirement that touches a second capability should not touch this service.
